note: Media - Parent Entity Link adds a 'Link to parent entity' checkbox to the image field formatters of MEDIA entities (via hook_field_formatter_third_party_settings_form). It has no settings page (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no plugins. The checkbox appears only for a media entity's field of type image whose formatter id is in InitialSettingsService::getFormatters() (default ['image','responsive_image']); other modules extend that list via hook_media_parent_entity_link_alter_formatters(). Enabling it stores third_party_settings.media_parent_entity_link.link_to_parent = '1' on that formatter component in core.entity_view_display.media.<bundle>.<view_mode>. At render (hook_media_media_view) it walks $entity->_referringItem->getParent()->getParent()->getValue() to the parent (referencing) entity and sets each image #url to $parent->toUrl(). Cases are grounded in that real third-party setting on the site's media Image displays (default view mode = field_media_image; media_library view mode = thumbnail); setup/reset/cleanup only add or remove this module's own third-party key, restoring baseline exactly.

evals.prompt: What does the media_parent_entity_link module add, and where do I turn it on? It has no admin settings page.
evals.expected_output: It adds a 'Link to parent entity' checkbox to a media entity's image field formatter on the media bundle's Manage display page. Ticking it stores third_party_settings.media_parent_entity_link.link_to_parent='1' on that formatter component in core.entity_view_display.media.<bundle>.<view_mode>; at render the media's image links to the referencing (parent) entity's URL.

evals.prompt: On which field formatters does the media_parent_entity_link 'Link to parent entity' option appear by default, and what kind of field does it require?
evals.expected_output: The option appears only for a media entity's field of type 'image' whose formatter is in the default supported list: 'image' and 'responsive_image' (InitialSettingsService::getFormatters()).

evals.prompt: I use the Blazy image formatter for my media. How can I make the media_parent_entity_link 'Link to parent entity' option available for another formatter like blazy?
evals.expected_output: Implement hook_media_parent_entity_link_alter_formatters(&$formatters) in a custom module and append the formatter id, e.g. $formatters[] = 'blazy'; (you still need to confirm that formatter honors the injected #url).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the media Image type's default display has one image field whose formatter is configured with media_parent_entity_link to link to the parent entity. Inspect the live view-display configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_media_image: in core.entity_view_display.media.image.default its image formatter component has third_party_settings.media_parent_entity_link.link_to_parent = '1'.

evals.prompt: On this site, exactly one view display of the media Image type has media_parent_entity_link's 'Link to parent entity' enabled on its image formatter. Inspect the live configuration and state which view mode (display) that is.
evals.expected_output: It is the media_library view display: core.entity_view_display.media.image.media_library has its 'thumbnail' image component with third_party_settings.media_parent_entity_link.link_to_parent = '1'; the default display does not.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the media_parent_entity_link module to configure the media Image type's DEFAULT view display so that the image field (field_media_image) links to the parent (referencing) entity. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.media.image.default the field_media_image image formatter component carries third_party_settings.media_parent_entity_link.link_to_parent = '1' (e.g. set the component's third_party_settings and save, or tick 'Link to parent entity' on the formatter in Manage display).

evals.prompt: When my media images show up in the media library grid, I want each thumbnail to link to the page that uses it. Using the media_parent_entity_link module, turn on 'link to parent entity' for the media Image type's media_library display (its thumbnail image), and save it live.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.media.image.media_library the 'thumbnail' image formatter component carries third_party_settings.media_parent_entity_link.link_to_parent = '1'.
